name: Empty-space skipping via Acceleration Structure
aliases: Empty Space Skipping via Acceleration Structure
Empty space skipping via the acceleration structure
definition: An optimization where a per-field min/max acceleration structure of 32x32x32 bricks lets the ray jump over regions that do not contain visible data.
summary: Empty-space skipping via Acceleration Structure accelerates volume rendering by using a hierarchical min/max structure to skip transparent blocks, distinct from methods using sparse voxel grids or bounding box trees.
